title: Construction Scheduler
description:
JOB TITLE: Construction Scheduler

**TOP SKILLS:**

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience developing and maintaining construction schedules for large-scale, complex projects — data center, mission-critical, industrial, or energy infrastructure experience strongly preferred.
  • Expert proficiency in Primavera P6; working knowledge of Microsoft Project or equivalent.
  • Deep understanding of construction sequencing, critical path methodology (CPM), and earned value management (EVM).
  • Experience reviewing and challenging GC-submitted schedules and managing schedule compliance through construction.

LOCATION: Austin, TX with 20% travel involved
DURATION: 8+ month long contract with potential for extension/conversion
RATE RANGE: Pay rate: Market rate but target $80-115/hr

POSITION SUMMARY:
This is a high-impact contractor role sitting at the intersection of design, construction, and program management. You will own the integrated master schedule for active construction programs — from early sitework and mass grading through MEP installation, commissioning, and facility turnover — and work closely with our Design & Engineering, Construction, and Real Estate teams to ensure every project delivers on time.


RESPONSIBILITIES:
Schedule Development & Ownership

  • Develop, own, and maintain integrated master schedules for multiple concurrent data center construction programs from NTP through turnover, using Primavera P6 or equivalent scheduling software.
  • Build project-specific construction schedules incorporating civil, structural, MEP, technology, and specialty scopes, coordinating logic ties and dependencies across all disciplines.
  • Establish and maintain early work package schedules (mass grading, underground utilities, site enablement) to protect critical path and accelerate overall program delivery.
  • Develop commissioning and systems integration schedules in alignment with construction milestones, ensuring phased energization and turnover sequences are captured and tracked.
Program Reporting & Risk Management
  • Produce weekly and monthly schedule status reports for project teams and leadership, clearly communicating schedule health, critical path, float consumption, and near-term look-ahead windows.
  • Identify schedule risks, delays, and interdependency conflicts ahead of the team — flag issues before they become problems and drive resolution across GC, design, and owner teams.
  • Maintain a portfolio-level schedule dashboard giving leadership real-time visibility into milestone status across all active programs.
  • Perform schedule impact analysis for change events, weather delays, supply chain disruptions, and other schedule-affecting conditions; support time impact analysis (TIA) and claim review.
GC & Consultant Coordination
  • Review and validate GC-submitted construction schedules for logic, resource loading, sequencing, and alignment with contract milestones; provide written comments and track resolution.
  • Facilitate schedule alignment meetings with GCs, subcontractors, and design teams; drive accountability to schedule commitments and document decisions.
  • Coordinate long-lead equipment delivery schedules with procurement and ensure they are integrated into the master program schedule with appropriate float and contingency.
  • Interface with design and engineering teams to ensure design deliverable schedules are tied to construction need dates and procurement milestones.
Standards & Infrastructure
  • Build Fluidstack's scheduling templates, WBS structures, coding standards, and baseline schedule frameworks to support rapid program startup across new sites.
  • Establish schedule review cadences, update protocols, and reporting templates that create consistency and accountability across the portfolio.
  • Maintain historical schedule data and lessons learned to continuously improve schedule accuracy and baseline assumptions for future programs.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  • 7+ years of experience developing and maintaining construction schedules for large-scale, complex projects — data center, mission-critical, industrial, or energy infrastructure experience strongly preferred.
  • Expert proficiency in Primavera P6; working knowledge of Microsoft Project or equivalent.
  • Deep understanding of construction sequencing, critical path methodology (CPM), and earned value management (EVM).
  • Experience reviewing and challenging GC-submitted schedules and managing schedule compliance through construction.
  • Strong analytical skills — able to model schedule impacts, communicate float and risk clearly, and translate complex schedule data into actionable leadership reporting.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs in a fast-paced, owner/developer environment.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites across the US (estimated 20–30%).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in hyperscale data center, large-scale industrial, or mission-critical facility construction scheduling.
  • Familiarity with modular and prefabricated construction delivery models and how they integrate with site construction schedules.
  • Experience with phased campus delivery — managing multiple buildings and infrastructure packages across a single site.
  • Proficiency with BIM coordination platforms (Autodesk Client / BIM 360, Navisworks) and how model-based workflows intersect with scheduling.
  • Exposure to commissioning scheduling for complex MEP and electrical systems including HV/MV switchgear, chillers, UPS, and generator systems.
  • PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP), AACE Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP), or equivalent credential.
  • Owner/developer-side experience — managing GC schedule compliance rather than producing schedules as the GC.

BENEFITS SUMMARY: Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate or annual salary only, unless otherwise stated. In addition to base compensation, full-time roles are eligible for Medical, Dental, Vision, Commuter and 401K benefits with company matching.

title: Senior Architect, Data Center Development
description:
JOB TITLE: Architect, Data Center Design

**TOP 3 SKILLS:**
• Bachelor's degree in Architecture or equivalent discipline.
• 3+ years of experience on industrial or data center projects within an AEC environment.
• Proficiency with Bluebeam, Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, and Autodesk Construction Cloud.
• Strong working knowledge of building codes, fire and life safety requirements, and data center construction standards.

LOCATION: Austin, TX with 20-25% travel involved
DURATION: 8+ month long contract with potential for extension/conversion
RATE RANGE: Pay rate: Market rate but target $90-125/hr

POSITION SUMMARY:
The Architect is a core member of Fluidstack's Data Center Design and Engineering team. You will own the architectural workstream across a multi-site, multi-state development portfolio from early-stage concept through design, permitting, and construction completion. This is an owner/developer role. You will manage external architects and engineers of record, coordinate across civil, structural, and MEP disciplines, and interface with GCs, AHJs, and operations stakeholders. You will be the subject matter authority on building envelope, life safety, space planning, and code compliance across some of the largest data center campuses in development.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Building Design & Standards
• Develop and maintain the architectural basis of design, prototype drawing packages, master specifications, and reference designs for Fluidstack's campus portfolio. • Lead masterplan and campus layout development: building positioning, setbacks, service access, security zoning, and phasing logic across multi-building sites. • Own building envelope design - cladding systems, roofing assemblies, curtainwall, louvers, and penetration detailing - in compliance with FM Global requirements. • Develop space planning, adjacency standards, door and hardware schedules, access control zoning, and security tier separations, aligned to operational SLA requirements. • Integrate architectural scope with structural, MEP, fire protection, and civil teams.

Design Management
• Manage external architects and engineers of record from schematic through IFC - review deliverables, enforce standards, and track design quality and schedule across multiple concurrent projects. • Author and negotiate AOR scope of work, design contracts, and owner design standards. • Facilitate RFI and submittal review during construction; maintain design intent through field conditions and contractor-driven changes.

Permitting & Code Compliance
• Lead permitting strategy across jurisdictions: building permits, zoning/entitlement, variances, and AHJ coordination. • Ensure designs comply with IBC, IFC, NFPA 75, NFPA 76, NFPA 855, applicable state codes, and ADA requirements. • Coordinate fire-rated construction, egress, and life safety design with fire protection engineers and local authorities.

Construction Administration
• Review contractor submittals, RFIs, mock-ups, and material samples; conduct site visits at critical quality milestones. • Manage architectural change order scope and participate in commissioning reviews for envelope, door hardware, access control, and fire/smoke separation systems. • Coordinate closeout, punchlist, and as-built documentation; capture lessons learned and integrate them into reference designs and master specifications.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Basic Qualifications
• Bachelors Architecture or Masters in Architecture from an accredited program.
• 7+ years of architectural experience, including 3+ years in data center or mission critical facility design.
• Licensed Architect, or active pursuit with expected licensure within 12 months.
• Experience managing external architects and consultants as an owner's representative or developer.
• Working knowledge of IBC, IFC, occupancy classifications, egress, and fire-rated assembly design. • Proficient in Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, and Procore.
• Willingness to travel to project sites across the US (~25%).

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in hyperscale data center or large-scale industrial development.
• Familiarity with FM Global envelope and roofing requirements and submittal process.
• Working knowledge of industrial cladding and roofing systems: attachment details, thermal movement, joint continuity, and air/vapor barrier integration.
• Experience authoring owner-side design standards, prototype specifications, or basis of design documents.
• LEED AP or demonstrated experience with sustainable envelope and energy compliance strategies.

Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate or annual salary only, unless otherwise stated. In addition to base compensation, full-time roles are eligible for Medical, Dental, Vision, Commuter and 401K benefits with company matching.
